rows.en: Whoooa there!!
Gwaaah!!
Waagh!!
Heh heh heh... Hahahaha...!! It's too late now!!
...Damn it!! Is this really the end...?
I... I can't fall... not in a place like this...!!
At that moment, something mysterious happened.
A blinding light burst from RX's body and neutralized the Shutdown Beam!!
Yes, RX had unleashed the King Stone Flash with every ounce of his strength!
...My body!! I can move! I can move!!
...My body!! I can move... I can still fight!!
...My body!! It moves... Now I can fight!!
...My body!! ...I can move!!
...My body!! It's moving... All right!! We can do this!!
...My body!! Oh... Now that we can move, this fight is ours!!
...Hell yeah! I can move again!! Now this fight's in the bag!!
...My body's free!! All right! Now I can do this!!
...All right!! Once my body's moving, this fight is mine!!
What!!!
Now's your chance... Strike down The O...
Right!! Let's do this!!
The O!!! Get out of heeere!!!
I can see it!! There!!
The O!! I will sever that distortion myself!!
The O!! I'll kill you!!
The O!!! Someone like you...!!
The O!! Now, count up your sins!!
You've been mocking us long enough!! Here I go, at my climax right from the staaart!!
The O...!! I can't let you live!!
The O!! I couldn't move before, so now I'm gonna cut loose all I want!!
What...
Ngh... You people... You possess a "power" unknown to me!?
But don't think you can beat me!! You brat!!!
Ngh... You people... You possess a "power" unknown to me!?
But even that power... will soon be ours as well...
When that time comes, it will be your end...
Where The O had vanished, something lay on the ground.
Obtained the "Pelucidar Drill".
...Well done.
RX!! Are you all right!?
RX...!! Are you okay!?
Are you all right?
You all right?
RX!! Are you all right!?
RX...!! You okay!?
Hey! RX!! ...You in one piece!?
RX!! Are you all right!?
RX...!! You okay!?
...Yes. But I've used up all my energy.
Please, take it easy. Let's get you to our base right away!!
Take it easy. I'll get you to our base right away!!
Take it easy. I'll take you to our base at once.
Don't move. I'll get you to our base right away.
Please, take it easy. Let's get you to our base right away.
Take it easy. We'll get you to our base right away.
Just take it easy. I'm gettin' ya to our base right now!!
Please rest easy. Let's get you to our base right away!!
Take it easy. I'll get you to our base in no time!!
Aw, hell...!!
...Who's there!?
...Geez. If the boss here goes and croaks, what happens to my bonus!?
Arche Gundam!!
Arche Gundam!!
Arche Gundam!!
Arche Gundam!!
Arche Gundam!!
Arche Gundam!!
Arche Gundam!!
Arche Gundam!!
Arche Gundam!!
Whoa there. Nobody's ordered me to fight you lot just yet.
But I'll be sure to tell the bigwigs all about how you fought just now.
See ya!!
Hey, wait...!!
...Wasn't The O the one pulling his strings?
...Bigwigs? Wasn't The O the one pulling his strings?
...Bigwigs? Wasn't The O the one pulling his strings?
...Wasn't The O the one pulling his strings?
...Bigwigs, he said? Wasn't Arche working for The O...?

notes.note: #0.77-0.85 (from story_041) are 9 leader-variant hit reactions; #0.83-0.85 are variants 7-9. Throughout 0256 the 9 variants read, by content, as: 1 Zeta Gundam (Kamille), 2 Nu Gundam, 3 00, 4 Wing Zero, 5 OOO (calls Ankh by name in story_043 #0.178, polite to RX), 6 W, 7 Den-O (Momotaros), 8 Mebius (polite, 'Ankh-san'), 9 Zero. Variant 1 is always mislabelled 'Zero' by the extractor. Mapping is inferred; voices set from it.
Source trails off ('here, of all places...'); restored the verb as 'can't fall' and kept it unfinished.
The famous Black RX narration line (sono toki, fushigi na koto ga okotta); kept as a plain, recognisable sentence.
Kinou teishi beam rendered 'Shutdown Beam'. Not in glossary; story_041 #0.29/#0.41 (untranslated at time of writing) must use the same name.
'King Stone' / 'King Stone Flash' (RX's King Stone) not in glossary; standard English names used.
W variant; 'we' because W is the Shotaro+Philip duo (source has no subject).
Labelled Ankh; an eager 'yoshi, yaru zo' is a little out of voice for Ankh but the label was kept and the line left neutral.
Labelled Zero but this is Kamille's signature line to Scirocco (koko kara inaku nare), i.e. variant 1 = Zeta Gundam. Rendered 'Get out of here!!' to stay recognisable.
Variant 5 (OOO by the inferred mapping). Source deliberately cut off ('someone like you...'); kept unfinished.
Momotaros' catchphrase adapted from the glossary fixed line ('at my climax right from the start'), joined to 'here I go'.
Unlabelled duplicate of #0.122; The O speaking. #0.119-0.120 appear to be the Zeta-led branch: The O ends by shouting 'kozou' (boy/brat) at Kamille, rendered 'You brat!!!'.
Item 'Perushidaa Doriru': Pelucidar is the Science Patrol's drill tank from Ultraman (1966); English spelling 'Pelucidar' used. Not in glossary; check against the item table.
#0.131 (00) and #0.132 (Wing Zero) are identical in Japanese; #0.132 made curter for Heero.
Speaker '???' is Arche Gundam (Ali), revealed in #0.150.
'Taishou' = the boss of this place, i.e. The O. 'Kutabaru' rendered at strength as 'croaks'.
'O-eragata' rendered 'bigwigs' (as in earlier slices); #0.165-0.168 echo it.
'Haigo ni ita' = was behind him / backing him; rendered 'pulling his strings'.

report: 80/80 rows. 0256 leader variants (9 per line) mapped by content to Zeta, Nu, 00, Wing Zero, OOO, W, Den-O, Mebius, Zero; variant 1 mislabelled 'Zero' (e.g. #0.108 is Kamille's line). #0.107 Ankh label slightly out of voice. Not in glossary: 'Shutdown Beam' (must match story_041), 'King Stone'/'King Stone Flash', 'Pelucidar Drill' (item).
